crossRefs.note: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land.

parallels.note: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: So Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.
translations.bsb: Then Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.
translations.kjv: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.
translations.asv: So Joshua sent the people away, every man unto his inheritance.
